pr_body:
This adjusts the low pass in line with proposal at #15060. This includes changing the duration and easing of the effects to better match visuals, but also adding a return to original frequency range on entering gameplay. It felt weird having it not match visually until now.

Also fixes the cutoff restoration not working on `PlayerLoader.Exit` due to underlying bindables getting unbound from the `ValueChanged` event.

Closes #15060.
pr_comments: Ended in an almost complete rewrite, apologies.

issue_context.title: PlayerLoader low pass filter has issues
issue_context.body:
- It should be fading over a longer period and probably be inside `contentIn()`.  `CutoffTo(1000, 650, OutQuint)` feels much closer to where it should be
- The restoration on exiting just doesn't work and never did. For whatever reason it happens immediately regardless of values set, even when accounting for screen expiry.

review_comments: It's maybe a hair too slow - can still hear the transform slightly after the entering sound, but let's see what other people say.
hmm, it's supposed to be in sync with the osu! logo movement, not the enter sound.

Maybe so but it's a little bit jarring for me audibly. Didn't notice the sync with the osu! logo at all in comparison. I could be biased because I'm specifically paying attention to the effect, though.
How does it feel on master in comparison? I made this change because previously it was super jarring to me.

Master's jarring because it's too fast, but less jarring than this to me overall.

I think we just need to try it out and get more opinions/see if it starts annoying you, because I'm definitely confirmation biased and see your point regarding the logo as I reduce the duration to negate the effect (250ms is the earliest value at which I can't clearly notice it).
